scope: Editorial comparison of all sixteen generated exchanges. These are assistant judgements; human preference remains unmeasured.

decisions.reason: The new question asks what happened to the convoy immediately after the opening says it was delayed.
Asking whether the stores reached their target repeats the entire opening. The closing is a stock expression of concern.
The earlier exchange asks how long the search for food lasted. The new exchange asks for the group that was just named.
The earlier exchange asks whether grain has arrived and preserves the limit of the account. The new exchange repeats what the money was for.
The new question asks which object was finished immediately after naming it. A reaction to the work would move the exchange forward.
The new answer preserves uncertainty and the title, but asks for a rank already given. The earlier closing about carrying things fits the title poorly.
The earlier exchange distinguishes the growing calf from the older worker. The new answer mostly repeats the opening.
The new ending reads clearly and reacts to the fodder shortage. The earlier ending is awkward. The new question still repeats the stated cause.
The earlier short death notice leaves room for the question about home. The new opening supplies the home and then asks for it again.
The tiredness reaction fits the work. The question and answer repeat the method already stated, so the exchange would be stronger in two turns.
The new exchange avoids the earlier repeated closing. Its wheat confirmation is readable, although the answer carries more repeated wording than it needs.
The new question asks where the stone will go after the opening already says roads and public works.
Both versions confirm stone, but the earlier yes is shorter. Repeating used stone and the hearsay cue adds stiffness.
The earlier exchange adds a small distinction between yearlings and growing lambs. The new question repeats their place in the adult flock.
The opening states that wool was stored. The next two turns ask and answer what happened to the wool.
The mutton destination adds a source fact omitted from the opening. The earlier ending breaks down. The new closing remains generic.
